|x13 = -101.5 |y13 = 79.12 |z13 = -175.5 }} '''Elle''' is an [[NPC]] on the {{zone|Crimson Isle}}. She acts as a guide, and helps explain the new systems, factions and mobs there. == Quests == '''Elle''' is one of the main [[NPCs]] for the [[Crimson Isle Main Questline]] for both [[Factions]]. She first appears in the {{Zone|Stronghold}} trying to fight three {{MobSprite|Blaze (Elle's Quest);Blazes}}, after which she tasks the player with bringing her {{Item|Magma Chunk|amount=4}}, {{Item|Blaze Ashes|amount=3}} and {{Item|Spectre Dust|amount=2}}. After the player does this, '''Elle''' will start leaving the Stronghold. She will be in front of the {{Zone|Chief's Hut}} within {{Zone|Dragontail}}, and outside the {{Zone|Community Center (Scarleton)}} within {{Zone|Scarleton}}. She will then task the player with speaking to four [[NPCs]] from each [[Faction]], so that they can make their mind up about which one they want to join. The quest then splits depending on which faction was chosen. '''Elle''' is also required to access the Basic Tier of the [[Kuudra]] fight. She will take the player there after they have completed their Faction's entire questline. == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable centertext" ! colspan="2" |Condition !Dialogue |- class="article-row-main" | rowspan="2" class="ct" |Before killing the 3 [[Blaze (Elle's Quest)|Blaze]]s | rowspan="2" class="ct"| Random |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &cElle&f: ONE SECOND I'M PRETTY BUSY RIGHT NOW!}} |- |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &cElle&f: COULD YOU HELP ME INSTEAD OF JUST SITTING THERE?!}} |- | colspan="2" class="ct" |After killing the 3 [[Blaze (Elle's Quest)|Blaze]]s |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Wow, that was something! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I'm immune to fire but those monsters are still quite troublesome... &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Thanks for your help, I seriously appreciate that. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I'm in a bit of a hurry, though.
